property_summary: Only the depositorAccount address stored in C may successfully call setL1BlockValues; calls from any other address must revert and leave C's observable state unchanged (number, timestamp, basefee, hash, sequenceNumber, batcherHash, l1FeeOverhead, l1FeeScalar remain equal).
Calling setL1BlockValues from the depositor account (the stored depositorAccount) does not revert; calling from any other account reverts and leaves all public observable state unchanged.
Calling setL1BlockValues either reverts or updates all of C's public L1 block fields to exactly the provided arguments (no partial updates).
